title: 第11章 成就气血境第12章 救死扶伤
slug: 我在民俗世界打造洞天福地

“没想到布下那么多陷阱，结果还是让那头独目鬼给跑了！”
“它实力应该是接近了二阶精怪的层次，估计用不了多久就会突破。”
“我早就说过别去招惹这头精怪，现在它已经彻底盯上了咱们黑山村，要真叫它哪天进阶成功，咱们黑山村将绝无活口，连只鸟都飞不出去！”
“事情已经发生了，你现在说这个有什么用！”
黑山村。
祠堂。
八九个人围坐在院落中一起议事。
其中有几位都是村里面辈分较高的老人。
其余人则是如今村子里的中流砥柱，都是踏入了气血境后期的修行者，共同主持着黑山村大大小小的事务。
“这头独目鬼已经凝聚出了精元，如果能够得到这枚精元，咱们村未必不能出一位破开气血境枷锁的强者！”
“距离咱们最近的岩岭村，他们早些年出了一位超越气血境的强者，已经无需惧怕二阶精怪的袭击，现在日子过得多好！”
“这些年还猎杀了不少弱一些的二阶妖兽，把他们村的整体战力拔高了不少！”
“如果咱们黑山村也能有一位这样的强者，对咱们整个村子都是莫大的好事！”
“富贵险中求啊，观海叔，咱们不拼一把，怎么让黑山村变得更强大？”
刘万禾目光看向莫观海，语气铿锵有力。
莫观海摇头叹气说道，“我只希望咱们村子能够安稳就好，其他的说什么都是虚妄。”
“放心，观海叔，我们定然不会让独目鬼那畜生成功进阶的。”
院落中，还有几人和刘万禾站在了同一立场上。
莫观海浑浊的眸子扫过他们，这帮人都是曾经和他一同创建了黑山村的故人之后。

数十年过去，看来这帮娃儿也已经有了想要掌权的心思了，连长辈的话也愿意不听了。
现场的气氛一时间有些凝滞，在场的人隐隐分为两个派系。
其中一派是以刘万禾为首的狩猎队成员，另一派则是莫观海为首的老一辈，以及黑山村的村长黄信。
“信哥，怎么说？以我们的实力，联手之下未必怕了那独目鬼！”刘万禾看向黄信，自信说道。
黄信不置可否，只是道：“如果真有胜算，我当然是想拿下这头独目鬼。”
随后他话音一转。
“不过，试过两次都失手了，我这心里也没底啊。”
“一般都是只有二阶精怪才会凝聚出精元，那绝非我们可以图谋的，咱们好不容易遇到一头凝聚了精元的一阶精怪，难道就这么放过了不成？”
对于黄信的犹豫，刘万禾心中很是不屑，但此刻却是面色极为诚恳地劝说着。
“行，那就再试试，继续探查独目鬼的踪迹。”
听到黄信终于松口答应，刘万禾心中一喜，连忙拍板说道：“好嘞，我们狩猎一队今天晚上继续行动！”
随着讨论结束，大家起身散去。
此时。
在刘万禾左手边的一位身材高大的壮汉忽然开口道：“万禾，沈云那座屋子的灵纹似乎没有失效，木屋现在还没被精怪破坏。”
“反正也就是这几天的事罢了，不用管。”
闻言，刘万禾毫不在意地摆摆手。
沈云夫妻俩实力低下，他们的孩子直到十五六岁才堪堪将身子养起来。
最大的那个孩子练了将近一年蛮牛功，还未能够成就气血境，并非天赋出众之辈。
没有修行者的庇护，这三个孩子绝对活不下来。
“做好准备，今天晚上的行动绝对不能再出岔子了。”

……
“阿信，沈云那家子你打算怎么办？”
黄信家。

"I didn't expect to lay so many traps, but in the end, the one-eyed ghost escaped!"
"Its strength should be close to the level of a second-order spirit. It won't take long for it to break through."
"I have long said not to provoke this monster. Now it has completely set its sights on our Black Mountain Village. If it succeeds in advancing one day, our Black Mountain Village will have no survivors and not even a bird can fly out!"
"Things have already happened, what's the use of saying this now!"
Black Mountain Village.
Ancestral hall.
Eight or nine people sat around the courtyard to discuss matters.
Several of them are senior elders in the village.
The rest are now the mainstay of the village. They are all practitioners who have entered the late stage of Qi and Blood Realm. They jointly preside over the affairs of Black Mountain Village, large and small.
"This one-eyed ghost has condensed the essence. If we can get this essence, our village may not be able to produce a strong man who can break the shackles of the qi and blood realm!"
"Yanling Village, which is closest to us, had a strong man who transcended the Qi and Blood Realm a few years ago. They no longer need to be afraid of attacks from second-level spirits. Life is so good now!"
"They have also hunted down many weaker second-level monsters in the past few years, which has increased the overall combat power of their village a lot!"
"If we in Heishan Village can have such a strong man, it will be a great good thing for our entire village!"
"Wealth is sought in danger, Uncle Guanhai, if we don't work hard, how can we make Heishan Village stronger?"
Liu Wanhe looked at Mo Guanhai and spoke forcefully.
Mo Guanhai shook his head and sighed, "I just hope that our village can be stable. Anything else is false."
"Don't worry, Uncle Guanhai, we will definitely not let that beast of a one-eyed ghost successfully advance."
In the courtyard, there were several others who stood on the same ground as Liu Wanhe.
Mo Guanhai's cloudy eyes swept across them. These people were all old friends who had founded Heishan Village with him.
Decades have passed, and it seems that these kids have already wanted to take power, and are not even willing to listen to their elders.
The atmosphere at the scene was a little stagnant for a while, and the people present were vaguely divided into two factions.
One group is the members of the hunting team headed by Liu Wanhe, and the other group is the older generation headed by Mo Guanhai, and the village chief Huang Xin of Heishan Village.
"Brother Xin, what do you say? With our strength, we may not be afraid of the one-eyed ghost if we join forces!" Liu Wanhe looked at Huang Xin and said confidently.
Huang Xin was noncommittal and just said: "If there is a chance of winning, of course I want to capture this one-eyed ghost."
Then his voice changed.
"However, I have tried twice and failed, so I don't feel confident."
"Generally, only second-order spirits can condense essence. That is definitely not something we can plot. We finally encountered a first-order spirit that has condensed essence. Can we just let it go?"
Liu Wanhe was very disdainful of Huang Xin's hesitation, but at this moment he was persuading him with an extremely sincere expression.
"Okay, let's try again and continue to detect traces of the one-eyed ghost."
Hearing that Huang Xin finally agreed, Liu Wanhe felt happy and quickly said, "Okay, our hunting team will continue the operation tonight!"
As the discussion ended, everyone stood up and dispersed.
at this time.
A tall and strong man on Liu Wanhe's left suddenly said: "Wanhe, the spiritual patterns in Chen Yun's house seem to have not failed, and the wooden house has not been destroyed by the spirits yet."
"It's just a matter of these few days anyway, don't worry about it."
Hearing this, Liu Wanhe waved his hand indifferently.
Chen Yun and his wife were of low strength, and their child could not be raised until he was fifteen or sixteen years old.
The eldest child has been practicing Barbarian Ox Kung Fu for nearly a year, but has not yet been able to achieve the Qi and Blood Realm. He is not a person with outstanding talent.
Without the protection of practitioners, these three children would never have survived.
"Get ready for tonight's tripDong must not make any mistakes again. "
…
"Axin, what are you going to do with Shen Yun's family? "
Huang Xinjia.
